claims: The 2026 TGL Finals are a best-of-three series between Jupiter Links GC and Los Angeles Golf Club.
Jupiter Links GC is led by Tiger Woods.
The 2026 TGL Finals are at the SoFi Center in Palm Beach Gardens, FL.
The 2026 TGL Finals are broadcast on ESPN.
Los Angeles Golf Club won the first match 6-5 on March 23.
The final matches are on Tuesday, March 24.
Tiger Woods is scheduled to make his season debut.
Los Angeles Golf Club defeated Jupiter Links GC 6-5 in Match 1 on March 23.
Match 2 is on March 24, 7 p.m. ET.
Match 2 is Jupiter Links (with Tiger Woods) vs. Los Angeles Golf Club.
Match 3 is on March 24, 9 p.m. ET if necessary.
The format is simulator-based match play.
Jupiter Links GC team members are Tiger Woods, Kevin Kisner, Max Homa, Tom Kim.
Los Angeles Golf Club team members are Sahith Theegala, Justin Rose, Tommy Fleetwood, Akshay Bhatia.
Tiger Woods is returning to play for the first time since the 2024 Open Championship.
Tiger Woods had back surgery in October 2025.
